items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: And Southern Stan, they used to work with us.

ctx.x: Then we did get to play for colored people, but they tried to take us away. And then we started selling bands in our place like a mother father did, you see. And Southern Stan get two jobs each of our band. One, that's when they started selling bands in our place like a mother father did, you see.
